messages:
alexa: starting quiet-window deploy v2026.03 -> canary 10% eu-west. please watch p95 and 5xx on SLO dash https://dash.redwood.local/slo/serve and call out any regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy kicked by alexa. canary=10% region=eu-west-1 version=v2026.03. CI=green. notifying @eng-oncall.

ryan: see embed route p95 jump to ~420ms ~90s ago (baseline ~200ms). no surge in 5xx yet.

sre-oncall: if p95 >350ms for >5m hold ramp and surface rollback plan. check kv_cache_hit_ratio; new shard mapping may cause cold misses.

alexa: pausing ramp. @deploy-bot hold-ramp. adding note to release draft about transient eu-west perf.

deploy-bot: hold acknowledged, canary remains at 10%.

tara: kv hit ratio eu-west=0.59 (baseline 0.9). recommending prewarm. I can fire prewarm job: `tools/prewarm_kv --region eu-west-1 --service=embeds` if SRE ok.

sre-oncall: go ahead. prepping rollback: rollback -> v2026.02 traffic shift 100% over 45s if no improvement in 10m.

tara: prewarm started. initial fill logs show warming.

ryan: p95 trending down to 260ms, kv hit -> 0.74. still no 5xx spike.

alexa: restarted one proxy pod that showed elevated latency just in case.

sre-oncall: pod restart complete, errors cleared. kv hit 0.82, p95 ~230ms. recommend ramp to 25% with 5m hold.

alexa: @deploy-bot ramp-to 25% over 2m hold 5m. tagging ENG-RELEASES in notes.

deploy-bot: ramp accepted. will auto-alert on p95>350ms or 5xx thresholds.

ryan: updating release note blurb: "Canary observed temporary eu-west latency due to KV cache warmup; prewarm and pod restart mitigated issue and ramp resumed."

alexa: thanks all. keep monitoring for 15m then proceed with full rollout if green. :thumbsup:
